span.p:
WebSocket
10 lakh log price poochh rahe
-> connection khula rehta, price badla tabhi server khud bhejta
user baar-baar nahi poochta
(WebSocket, pub/sub se servers tak)
second me 1000 baar badla -> har ~100 ms aakhri price
connection toota, wapas juda -> abhi ka price alag se do
10 lakh connection -> aur server + LB (ek pe ~lakh)
